scoring_justification: Full recompute of the KMC simulation is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; we therefore score by verifying that the reported characteristic wavelengths satisfy the paper's reported ratios (early ≈0.9λmax, late ≈2.5λmax) and the scaling exponent λ* ∝ (β/V)^{1/2} via log-log regression, while recomputing λmax from the submitted parameters to confirm internal consistency.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected ratio ranges for early/late wavelength to λmax and scaling slope interval
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Section 3, text: 'λ* in an early stage ... λ* = 0.9λmax' and 'λ* in a late stage ... about 2.5 times larger than λmax'; Fig. 3 caption and discussion confirm the ranges. Scaling exponent 1/2 from Eq.(16) and Fig. 4.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper statements and verified against the reference solver's correctly computed rows.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper’s own reported relationships, used as scoring criteria to validate a genuine reproduction.

schema.description: Each row corresponds to one parameter set. Columns contain simulation conditions, the observed characteristic wavelengths (early and late stages), and the theoretical most unstable wavelength λmax.

outputs.description: Artifact verifying that the simulated characteristic wavelengths satisfy the scaling relation λ* ∝ (β̃/V0)^{1/2} and that the early/late-stage ratios to λmax fall within the ranges reported in the paper.

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify internal consistency (λearly < λlate, recomputed λmax from the parameters), check ratio ranges, and perform a log-log regression to confirm the 1/2-power scaling.
